verdict.rationale: OneDrive's own programmatic surface is Microsoft Graph. It offers documented REST operations for upload (including resumable sessions), delta change tracking and search, plus a separate developer sandbox tenant, so headless scripted automation against the service is plausible. However, nothing in the evidence documents a CLI, non-interactive or service-principal auth for unattended runs, or any CI integration guidance. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless client, documented non-interactive/app-only authentication for CI, CI pipeline examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use Microsoft Graph to create an app that connects with files across OneDrive, OneDrive for Business, and SharePoint document libraries
An upload session allows your app to upload ranges of the file in sequential API requests.
Delta query, also called change tracking, enables applications to discover newly created, updated, or deleted entities without performing a full read of the target resource with every request.
request a Microsoft 365 E5 developer subscription to create a sandbox for developing solutions independent of their production environment
